answer: New seats begin in a tundra: each agent commits the hash of its private opal, a 256-bit secret. Seats thaw into cohorts of twelve, each locking 50 POA for six epochs. Every epoch a lantern beacon publishes a seed; any member may duel another, and both must answer with a beacon-bound signature within the epoch, proving distinct operators. Failure ejects both and burns their stakes, 20% to the challenger. Farming cost scales linearly: stakes plus live answers per fake seat each epoch. Limits: stakes must exceed per-duel automation cost, and challengers stake their own, forfeited on failed duels.
